title: Chapter 290
text:
The sanctuary was packed with people. Other than the participants, there were also spectators. It was more than ten times livelier than before. The players' stalls could almost line up from the square to the city gate. The whole city was in a frenzy.

The Division Tournament was a big event for players all over the planet. Those who were not there could watch the broadcast on the forums.

There were three days before the tournament, and one day was the fixed time for Black Phantom to open the chests. A large number of players came to the sanctuary personally. Other than wanting to watch the tournament, they also came because of Han Xiao.

The place where he usually appeared was already surrounded by a group of people. A male player stood outside the crowd and tiptoed to look into the circle.

"It's about time," the male player mumbled softly.

The male player's ID was' Jingzhe '. He was a LV 20 novice Mechanic player, one of the inconspicuous spectators. At this time, in this chaotic sanctuary, he was basically no different from a human background. He was a small transparent character. He knew about Han Xiao's various functions from the forums, so he wanted to buy some low-level equipment. His purpose was different from the people around him who were waiting to get their hands chopped off.

There would be such newbies every once in a while, giving Han Technician a steady stream of income.

After waiting for a while, Han Xiao drove the truck over and stopped steadily after a 270 degree drift. He dusted his hands and jumped out of the truck. The players who were waiting at the side immediately swarmed forward and fought to buy the boxes.

There were limited chests, so Jing Zhe was pushed around by the crowd.

After the boxes were sold out, the crowd dispersed. Jing Zhe finally heaved a sigh of relief. Seeing that Han Xiao was still there, he immediately got up and jogged over, expressing that he wanted to learn a skill. As expected, he saw the shop list.

"So many machines, seems like I can learn skills too. This NPC has so many functions. I heard that he used to be the main character of the storyline. Very awesome …" Jing Zhe was a newbie. He only started playing after the Germinal Organization main storyline ended, so he did not know much about Han Xiao's past.

The items in the skill shop made him very excited. When he scrolled to the bottom, Jing Zhe's eyes widened.

"This is … the advanced knowledge of the Pugilist and Esper classes, [Gas Burst] and [Level Two Genetic Chain — Endurance Enhancement]. Both are priced at 30,000 EXP." Jing Zhe was very surprised.

Isn't Black Phantom a Mechanic instructor? Why is he selling the advanced knowledge of the other two classes?

Unfortunately, he had no use for it.

Jing Zhe felt that it was a pity. He took a screenshot and posted a post on the forum. Then, he continued to browse the other products. However, he did not expect that his post would cause such an uproar!

All the knowledgeable players were shocked!!

Jing Zhe did not understand the scarcity of Class Advancement Knowledge, but the veteran players were very clear about it. They had to raise their relationship with the Six Nations to Reverence before they could exchange for Class Advancement Knowledge. Currently, almost no one could do that, but Han Xiao had put it up for sale without any warning or conditions!

There was only one sentence that could describe how the veteran players felt about Han Xiao.

This kid was actually so terrifying!

After a few months of silence, Han Xiao's name once again dominated the headlines!

Jing Zhe was stunned. He didn't expect that a random screenshot and post would cause such a huge response.

However, the scene that shocked him was yet to come. From afar, countless players rushed over after hearing the news. As far as the eye could see, they surrounded Han Xiao so tightly that not even a drop of water could escape. After confirming the existence of the two types of advanced knowledge, the players in the square were in an uproar!

Black Phantom was as awesome as always. He was the blessing of the players!

Suddenly, there was a commotion at the periphery of the crowd, and a path was automatically opened. Famous professional players walked in one after another. Li Ge, Hao Tian, Sun Eggplant, and so on, all gathered together, shining brightly!

The Pro League was about to start, and the appearance of the Class Advancement Knowledge was like rain from the sky to the professional players. No one dared to be left behind, so they all rushed over. Dozens of famous professional players surrounded Han Xiao — it was a sight to behold!

The surrounding players rarely had close contact with their idols, so they were unable to contain their excitement. They all screamed and cheered, and their voices soared into the sky.

Jing Zhe was completely stunned. A random post had attracted a bunch of professional players. He was used to being invisible and had never experienced such an experience. He was so excited that his whole body was shaking.

These professional players led the way and bought the Class Advancement Knowledge. Han Xiao looked at the experience on his interface that was rocketing up, reaching a few million every minute! He was overjoyed!

I didn't waste my time hoarding the Class Advancement Knowledge until now. What a huge profit! Han Xiao was secretly happy. He had expected the Class Advancement Knowledge to be so popular. In Version 1.0, the prerequisites to obtain Class Advancement Knowledge were very strict, and it was difficult for players to obtain them. However, he directly sold them without any prerequisites, so it would definitely shock all the players.

His Class Advancement Knowledge of two classes came from the Germinal Organization's mainframe. Now that the Germinal Organization had flown away, the Class Advancement Knowledge in his hands was the only one in the Blue Star Organization.

Hundreds of thousands of players gathered in the sanctuary. Excluding the Mechanics, players who did not have enough spending power, and players who did not have enough Potential Points, as long as one-tenth of them bought the Class Advancement Knowledge, he would still make a huge profit!

The price was set at 30,000, which was not a high amount for the current players. Han Xiao wanted to make a small profit because the participating players had spent most of their experience to increase their combat power and level up. There were only three days before the start of the Pro League. If the price was too high, he would miss out on those who could not afford it.

Han Xiao sold the Class Advancement Knowledge for a few hours until the sun started to set. Only then did he end the day.

He looked at the interface and saw that he had earned 300,000,000 experience on the first day.

In the past four months, Han Xiao had accumulated more than 500,000,000 experience through various activities. This time, it had increased by more than half!

Players have a stronger demand for Class Advancement Knowledge. The first few days are very profitable, but after that, the profit will decrease. However, just like other skills, it can last for a long time.

Han Xiao opened the forums. The Blue Star section was filled with posts about Class Advancement Knowledge. Many people were analyzing why he, a Mechanic, would suddenly sell the Class Advancement Knowledge of the other two classes.

The impact of this move even affected the sections of the other planets. The players of the other divisions were shocked and pressured. The relationship between the divisions was competitive. The Blue Star side easily obtained Class Advancement Knowledge, which was very disadvantageous for the other planets. This caused a lot of discussion among the players of the other planets.

Han Xiao was very famous on the Blue Star and occasionally made guest appearances in the Galaxy Times. However, most of his fame was limited to the Blue Star. This time, his fame spread to the other planets, and the players of the other regions started to remember his name. Blue Star Legendary NPC, Planet Storyline Protagonist, Black Phantom, Han Xiao, Open the Chest!

In fact, every planet had its own storyline protagonist. When participating in the main storyline, the storyline protagonist would be very active. However, as a storyline protagonist, Han Xiao was very different. He was completely unlike the other protagonists who frequently provided one round of main storyline mission after another. However, his functions were extremely rich. The Blue Star players received countless benefits from him.
